identity: A text document in which the user selects a requested span using native text selection.

scenarios.name: paragraph
scenarios.screen: Several paragraphs of text appear in reading order. The requested paragraph is visible as ordinary text, with no selection on it; another span can have a stray selection.
scenarios.scene: The paragraphs appear with no text selected.
never: Every paragraph has its own selection checkbox.

arrangements.text: Paragraphs sit one below another in a single text column.
Numbered clause titles sit directly above their paragraphs in a vertical terms document.
Messages sit one below another, with each sender and time beside its message text.
Text sits inside a scrolling document pane, with its scrollbar along the right edge.

scenarios.hint: Show three readable paragraphs; when canal is named exactly one paragraph discusses a canal. No selection yet. Keep all words legible and paragraphs separated.

scenarios.name: sentence
scenarios.screen: Several paragraphs of sentences appear in reading order. The target sentence remains part of its paragraph, with no selection on it; another span can have a stray selection.
scenarios.scene: The text appears with no selection.
never: Each sentence is a separate card.
Sentence selection buttons appear beside the text.

arrangements.text: Sentences flow within paragraphs stacked in one text column.
Numbered clause titles sit above their paragraphs, and sentences flow within each clause.
Sentences flow within cells arranged in rows and columns, with row and column labels around the cells.
The document sits in a scrolling pane with a scrollbar on its right edge.

scenarios.hint: Show three paragraphs of exactly three period-terminated sentences each. When cart is named, exactly one sentence mentions cart. Exact requested paragraph/sentence is visible; no selection yet.

scenarios.name: phrase
scenarios.screen: Several paragraphs contain the requested phrase within the running text. The phrase is not preselected, though another span can have a stray selection; some words can be links or bold text.
scenarios.scene: The document appears with no text selected.
never: The phrase appears in a separate answer box.
A text selection toolbar is open.

arrangements.text: Paragraphs sit in one column, with the phrase flowing across ordinary text lines.
The text sits inside one multiline text box, with paragraphs stacked within it.
The text occupies a single line inside an input field.
The document sits in a scrolling pane with its scrollbar along the right edge.

scenarios.hint: Show three complete readable paragraphs containing the exact requested phrase once in the requested paragraph. Do not insert quotation marks around the phrase or preselect it.

scenarios.name: word
scenarios.screen: Several paragraphs of text contain a single occurrence of the target word. The word is not preselected, though another span can have a stray selection.
scenarios.scene: The text appears with no selection.
never: The target word has its own checkbox.
A list of candidate words is open.
A separate answer field contains the target word.

arrangements.text: Paragraphs sit one below another, and the word appears within a line of text.
The text sits inside a multiline text box, with the word within one of its lines.
The text occupies a single-line input field, with the word among the other words.
Text cells fill a table in rows and columns, with the word inside one cell.

scenarios.name: field
scenarios.screen: A realistic message contains several values, such as an email address, tracking number or total, within its text. The requested value is not preselected, though another span can have a stray selection.
scenarios.scene: The message appears with no text selected.
never: Each value has a separate editable field.
Entity choices appear in an open menu.
The requested value is copied into an answer box.

arrangements.text: The message body sits in a single text column, with its values embedded in the lines.
Messages sit in chronological order, with sender and time beside each message body.
The message sits inside a multiline text box, with its values embedded in the text.
The message sits inside a scrolling pane with a scrollbar along its right edge.

scenarios.name: tip
scenarios.screen: Paragraphs of text contain a few dotted-underlined words. No tooltip is open at the start, and the target word is not selected; another span can have a stray selection.
scenarios.scene: The paragraphs and dotted-underlined words appear with no tooltip open and no text selected.
never: A tooltip is open before the pointer reaches an underlined word.
All tooltip hints appear in a separate panel.
The target word appears in a separate answer field.
The text sits inside an input field.

arrangements.text: Paragraphs sit one below another in a single text column, with underlined words embedded in their lines.
The paragraphs occupy a narrower text column, so their lines wrap sooner and the underlined words remain within the running text.
